label: Bidirectional synonym document
type: a synonym document with a single synonyms array defining a two-way relationship - a search for any term in the array can return any other term in it. Sibling of search:unidirectional-synonym-document.
evidence: Bidirectional synonym documents define a two-way synonym relationship. All terms are contained in a single synonyms array. Any search for a term in the synonyms array can return any other term in that array.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a group of terms be declared mutually synonymous in one document, rather than pairing each input term with its own output list?
